transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… my body’s been feeling kind of out of my control. I was pacing around the apartment all night, making these supper-club notes, and now lately I’m so slowed down my sister says it takes me forever just to get my shoes on.
Have you been feeling sad or empty lately?
I don’t know… sad, exactly. Maybe kind of blank sometimes. It’s hard to say.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
Maybe a little. I’m not really sure I’d call it anxious… I just feel kind of keyed up sometimes.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts that you can't stop thinking about?
Yeah… sometimes. It’s more like my thoughts start running too fast. I’ll think about recipes, then a logo, then who’d invest, then renting a place… and each one turns into more. It can keep me up.
Do you feel like you have to think about these things or is it just that your mind keeps wandering to them?

It’s not like I’m trying to think about them. My mind just kind of jumps there… recipes, then a logo, then investors, then a space to rent. One idea turns into a few more, and then I can’t really sleep.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely happy or irritable for several days?

Yeah… after I got fired, I had a stretch like that. I felt kind of… weirdly unstoppable, excited. But I’d also snap if anyone questioned what I was doing or told me to slow down. Like they were trying to ruin everything.
How long did that unstoppable, excited feeling last after you got fired?
About four months, I guess. It started after I got fired from the restaurant.
Are you currently feeling sad or empty most of the day?
I don’t know… not really most of the day. I get down sometimes, but I wouldn’t say empty all day.
Did you have any periods where you didn't need much sleep and still felt rested?
I’m not really sure. I mean, my sleep’s been weird sometimes, but I don’t know if I’d say I didn’t need it and felt rested.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely low or depressed for several days?
Yeah… I guess so. This heavy, slowed-down feeling has been going on for about three months now.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely happy or irritable and had lots of energy for several days in a row?

Yeah… there was a stretch after I got fired where I felt kind of… wired, like I could do anything. Excited, I guess. But I also got really angry if people questioned me or told me to slow down. Felt like they were against me.
Did you ever feel so good or hyper that you got into trouble or did things you later regret during those four months after you got fired?

Yeah… I guess it caused problems. I couldn’t really keep work stuff straight, or figure out rent things, or show up for family stuff like I was supposed to. It got bad enough that my sister took me to a crisis clinic because I just… couldn’t get basic things organized on my own.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt extremely happy or irritable for several days?

Maybe… I don’t know about more than one. The one I keep thinking of was after I got fired. I felt weirdly unstoppable, excited, like my plans all made sense. But if anyone questioned me or told me to slow down, I’d just… blow up, like they were trying to mess everything up for me.
Have you had any other times in your life, besides after you got fired, where you felt extremely happy or irritable for several days in a row?
I don’t really think so. Not like that. I mean, I’ve had bad moods or good days, but nothing that stands out the way that time did.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt extremely low or depressed for several days?
I don’t know about more than one. This low, heavy… slowed-down feeling has been going on for about three months now.
Have you had other times in your life where you felt extremely low or depressed for several days, besides the three months you've been feeling this way now?
Not really… I mean, I’ve been down before, but I don’t remember anything like this that lasted and stood out.
Have you had any other times in your life where you felt extremely happy or irritable for several days in a row, besides the time after you got fired?

Just that time after I got fired. I felt… kind of unstoppable, like really excited. But I was also snapping at people if they questioned me or told me to slow down. Like they were trying to mess everything up for me.
Have you ever had another time in your life where you felt extremely happy or irritable for several days in a row, besides the period after you got fired?
No… not that I can really think of. It was just after I got fired, when I felt kind of unstoppable and wired up. And I’d get really angry if people questioned me or told me to slow down.
Did your period of feeling unstoppable and excited after getting fired include a decreased need for sleep?
I don’t really know. I wasn’t paying that much attention to sleep then… I just remember feeling really keyed up.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt extremely happy or irritable for several days in a row?
No, I don’t think so. Just that time after I got fired… I felt weirdly unstoppable and excited, and then I’d blow up if people questioned me or told me to slow down.
